<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Zypher's — Cafe in Wakad, Pune</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,400;0,9..144,500;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,500&family=Karla:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --sand: #EDE6D8;
    --sand-2: #E4DAC7;
    --wood: #8B5E34;
    --wood-dark: #5E3F23;
    --bottle: #33463A;
    --bottle-light: #4A6152;
    --amber: #C98A3E;
    --ink: #2A2521;
    --ink-soft: #55493C;
    --paper: #FBF8F2;
    --line: rgba(42,37,33,0.14);
  }

  * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior:smooth; }

  body {
    background: var(--sand);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif;
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  h1, h2, h3, .display {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: var(--ink);
  }

  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  img { max-width: 100%; display:block; }
  button { font-family: inherit; }

  .wrap { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 32px; }

  /* ---------- Reveal animation ---------- */
  .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); transition: opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease; }
  .reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  .reveal-stagger.in > * { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  .reveal-stagger > * { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); transition: opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease; }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: .02s; }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: .08s; }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: .14s; }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: .20s; }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: .26s; }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: .32s; }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: .38s; }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(8) { transition-delay: .44s; }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(9) { transition-delay: .50s; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .reveal, .reveal-stagger > * { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; transition: none !important; }
  }

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  header {
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 200;
    background: rgba(237,230,216,0.94);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    transition: box-shadow .3s ease;
  }
  header.scrolled { box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(42,37,33,0.08); }
  nav.wrap { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; height: 74px; }
  .logo { font-family:'Fraunces', serif; font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink); }
  .logo span { color: var(--wood-dark); }
  .nav-links { display:flex; gap: 2.2rem; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; }
  .nav-links a { position:relative; padding: 4px 0; }
  .nav-links a::after {
    content:''; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:-2px; width:0; height:2px;
    background: var(--wood-dark); transition: width .25s ease;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover::after, .nav-links a.active::after { width:100%; }
  .nav-links a.active { color: var(--wood-dark); }

  .nav-right { display:flex; align-items:center; gap: 14px; }

  .btn {
    display:inline-block; padding: 12px 24px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 8px;
    transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease, transform .15s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
  }
  .btn-solid { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }
  .btn-solid:hover { background: var(--wood-dark); border-color: var(--wood-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); }

  .hamburger {
    display:none;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
    background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer;
    padding: 6px;
  }
  .hamburger span { width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--ink); display:block; transition: transform .25s ease, opacity .25s ease; }
  .hamburger.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg); }
  .hamburger.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
  .hamburger.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg); }

  .mobile-drawer {
    position: fixed; inset: 74px 0 0 0; z-index: 190;
    background: var(--paper);
    transform: translateX(100%);
    transition: transform .3s ease;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    padding: 40px 32px;
    gap: 28px;
  }
  .mobile-drawer.open { transform: translateX(0); }
  .mobile-drawer a { font-family: 'Fraunces', serif; font-size: 1.6rem; }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 92vh;
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-end;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .hero-bg {
    position: absolute; inset: 0;
    background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(42,37,33,0.18) 0%, rgba(28,22,17,0.80) 100%), url('data:image/jpeg;base64,');
    background-size: cover;
    background-position: center 30%;
    animation: kenburns 22s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes kenburns {
    from { transform: scale(1.0); }
    to { transform: scale(1.08); }
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .hero-bg { animation: none; } }

  .hero-inner { position: relative; color: var(--paper); padding-bottom: 76px; width:100%; }
  .rating-tag {
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap: 8px;
    background: rgba(251,248,242,0.12);
    border: 1px solid rgba(251,248,242,0.35);
    padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 2px;
    font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 22px;
  }
  .rating-tag .stars { color: var(--amber); letter-spacing: 2px; }
  .hero h1 {
    font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5.2vw, 4.3rem);
    line-height: 1.08;
    color: var(--paper);
    max-width: 16ch;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .hero p.lede { font-size: 1.1rem; max-width: 46ch; color: rgba(251,248,242,0.82); margin-bottom: 32px; }
  .hero-actions { display:flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .hero .btn-ghost { border-color: rgba(251,248,242,0.6); color: var(--paper); }
  .hero .btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); }

  .scroll-cue {
    position: absolute; bottom: 26px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    color: rgba(251,248,242,0.7);
    font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 600;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap: 8px;
    transition: color .2s ease;
  }
  .scroll-cue:hover { color: var(--paper); }
  .scroll-cue::after {
    content: ''; width: 1px; height: 26px; background: rgba(251,248,242,0.5);
    animation: cue 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes cue { 0%,100% { transform: scaleY(1); opacity: .6; } 50% { transform: scaleY(0.5); opacity: 1; } }

  /* ---------- Info strip ---------- */
  .info-strip {
    background: var(--bottle);
    color: var(--sand);
    padding: 16px 0;
  }
  .info-strip .wrap {
    display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap: 8px 28px; justify-content:center;
    font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 600;
  }
  .info-strip span:not(:last-child)::after { content:'·'; margin-left: 28px; color: var(--amber); }

  /* ---------- About ---------- */
  .about { padding: 100px 0; }
  .about-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr; gap: 64px; align-items:center; }
  .eyebrow { color: var(--wood-dark); font-weight:700; font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 16px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
  .about h2 { font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.2vw, 2.5rem); margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .about-copy p { margin-bottom: 16px; max-width: 56ch; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .about-stats { display:flex; gap: 40px; margin-top: 26px; }
  .stat .num { font-family:'Fraunces', serif; font-size: 2.2rem; color: var(--wood-dark); line-height:1; }
  .stat .label { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--ink-soft); margin-top: 4px; }

  /* ---------- Gallery ---------- */
  .gallery { padding: 0 0 100px; }
  .gallery-head { margin-bottom: 28px; }
  .gallery-grid {
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    grid-auto-rows: 160px;
    grid-auto-flow: dense;
    gap: 14px;
  }
  .gallery-grid button { border: none; padding: 0; background: none; cursor: zoom-in; display:block; overflow:hidden; border-radius: 3px; position: relative; }
  .gallery-grid img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition: transform .5s ease; display:block; }
  .gallery-grid button:hover img { transform: scale(1.06); }
  .g-tall { grid-row: span 2; }
  .g-wide { grid-column: span 2; }
  .g-big { grid-column: span 2; grid-row: span 2; }
  .g-caption {
    margin-top: 14px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--ink-soft);
    font-style: italic;
    font-family:'Fraunces', serif;
  }

  .lightbox {
    position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 300;
    background: rgba(20,16,13,0.92);
    display: none;
    align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    padding: 40px;
  }
  .lightbox.open { display:flex; }
  .lightbox img { max-width: 82vw; max-height: 85vh; border-radius: 4px; }
  .lightbox-close {
    position: absolute; top: 24px; right: 32px;
    background: none; border: 1px solid rgba(251,248,242,0.4); color: var(--paper);
    width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1.2rem; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .lightbox-nav {
    position: absolute; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
    background: none; border: 1px solid rgba(251,248,242,0.4); color: var(--paper);
    width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 1.3rem; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .lightbox-prev { left: 24px; }
  .lightbox-next { right: 24px; }
  .lightbox-nav:hover, .lightbox-close:hover { background: rgba(251,248,242,0.12); }
  .lightbox-count {
    position: absolute; bottom: 22px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    color: rgba(251,248,242,0.6); font-size: 0.82rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .lightbox-prev { left: 8px; } .lightbox-next { right: 8px; }
    .lightbox-nav { width: 38px; height: 38px; }
  }

  /* ---------- Menu ---------- */
  .menu-section { background: var(--paper); padding: 100px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .menu-head { max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto 54px; text-align:center; }
  .menu-head h2 { font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.2vw, 2.5rem); }
  .menu-head p { color: var(--ink-soft); margin-top: 12px; }
  .menu-list { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .menu-row {
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap: 24px;
    padding: 22px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    transition: padding-left .25s ease;
  }
  .menu-row:hover { padding-left: 8px; }
  .menu-row:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .menu-row .mname { font-family:'Fraunces', serif; font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .menu-row .mdesc { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink-soft); max-width: 48ch; }
  .menu-note { text-align:center; margin-top: 40px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .menu-cta { text-align: center; margin-top: 28px; }

  /* ---------- Reviews ---------- */
  .reviews { padding: 100px 0; }
  .reviews-head { max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto 50px; text-align:center; }
  .reviews-head h2 { font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.2vw, 2.5rem); }
  .reviews-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 26px; }
  .review-card { background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 3px; padding: 28px 24px; transition: transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease; }
  .review-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(42,37,33,0.08); }
  .review-card .stars { color: var(--amber); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 14px; letter-spacing:2px; }
  .review-card p.quote { font-family:'Fraunces', serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 18px; line-height: 1.5; }
  .review-card .who { font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-soft); }
  .review-card .who span { font-weight: 400; color: var(--wood-dark); }

  /* ---------- Visit / Reserve ---------- */
  .visit { background: var(--bottle); color: var(--sand); padding: 100px 0; }
  .visit-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 60px; }
  .visit h2 { color: var(--sand); font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 3.2vw, 2.5rem); margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .visit .eyebrow { color: var(--amber); }
  .info-row { display:flex; gap: 16px; padding: 16px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(251,248,242,0.14); }
  .info-row:first-of-type { border-top: 1px solid rgba(251,248,242,0.14); }
  .info-row .label { font-weight:700; font-size:0.8rem; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.05em; color: var(--amber); margin-bottom:4px; }
  .info-row .val { color: rgba(251,248,242,0.85); font-size: 0.95rem; }

  .visit-card {
    background: rgba(251,248,242,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(251,248,242,0.18);
    border-radius: 3px;
    padding: 36px;
    scroll-margin-top: 90px;
  }
  .visit-card h3 { color: var(--sand); font-size: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .visit-card > p { color: rgba(251,248,242,0.7); font-size: 0.92rem; margin-bottom: 24px; }
  .visit-card .btn-solid { background: var(--amber); border-color: var(--amber); color: var(--ink); width:100%; text-align:center; margin-top: 6px; }
  .visit-card .btn-solid:hover { background: var(--sand); border-color: var(--sand); }

  .field-row { display:flex; gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .field { flex:1; margin-bottom: 14px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap: 6px; }
  .field-row .field { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .field-narrow { flex: 0 0 90px; }
  .field label { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; color: var(--amber); }
  .field label span { text-transform:none; font-weight:400; color: rgba(251,248,242,0.5); }
  .field input, .field textarea {
    background: rgba(251,248,242,0.08);
    border: 1px solid rgba(251,248,242,0.25);
    border-radius: 2px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    color: var(--sand);
    font-family: 'Karla', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .field input::placeholder, .field textarea::placeholder { color: rgba(251,248,242,0.4); }
  .field input:focus, .field textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--amber); background: rgba(251,248,242,0.12); }
  .field textarea { resize: vertical; }
  .field input[type="date"]::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator,
  .field input[type="time"]::-webkit-calendar-picker-indicator { filter: invert(1); opacity: 0.7; }

  .form-note { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 0.86rem; min-height: 1.2em; }
  .form-note.error { color: #E39A9A; }
  .form-note.success { color: var(--amber); }

  @media (max-width: 520px) { .field-row { flex-direction: column; } .field-narrow { flex: 1; } }

  /* ---------- Terms ---------- */
  .terms { background: var(--paper); padding: 70px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
  .terms-inner { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .terms summary {
    cursor: pointer; font-family:'Fraunces', serif; font-size: 1.3rem; color: var(--ink);
    list-style: none; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
    padding-bottom: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .terms summary::-webkit-details-marker { display:none; }
  .terms summary::after { content: '+'; font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--wood-dark); }
  .terms[open] summary::after { content: '–'; }
  .terms-body { padding-top: 22px; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.92rem; }
  .terms-body h4 { font-family:'Karla',sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--ink); margin: 20px 0 8px; }
  .terms-body h4:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
  .terms-body p, .terms-body li { margin-bottom: 6px; }
  .terms-body ul { padding-left: 20px; }

  /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
  footer { background: var(--ink); color: rgba(251,248,242,0.55); padding: 44px 0 26px; }
  .footer-top {
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px;
    padding-bottom: 26px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(251,248,242,0.12); margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  .footer-top .logo { color: var(--paper); }
  .footer-top .logo span { color: var(--amber); }
  .footer-links { display:flex; gap: 22px; font-size: 0.86rem; }
  .footer-links a:hover { color: var(--paper); }
  .footer-bottom { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size: 0.78rem; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; }

  /* ---------- Back to top ---------- */
  .to-top {
    position: fixed; bottom: 28px; right: 28px; z-index: 150;
    width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 8px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size: 1.1rem;
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transform: translateY(10px);
    transition: opacity .25s ease, transform .25s ease, background .2s ease;
  }
  .to-top.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: translateY(0); }
  .to-top:hover { background: var(--wood-dark); }

  /* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 880px) {
    .nav-links, .nav-right .btn-solid { display:none; }
    .hamburger { display:flex; }
    .about-grid, .visit-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .gallery-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-auto-rows: 170px; }
    .g-tall, .g-big { grid-row: span 2; }
    .g-wide, .g-big { grid-column: span 2; }
    .reviews-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .about-stats { gap: 26px; }
  }

  :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--wood-dark); outline-offset: 3px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header id="site-header">
  <nav class="wrap">
    <a href="#top" class="logo">Zypher<span>'s</span></a>
    <div class="nav-links" id="nav-links">
      <a href="#about">About</a>
      <a href="#menu">Menu</a>
      <a href="#reviews">Reviews</a>
      <a href="#visit">Visit</a>
    </div>
    <div class="nav-right">
      <a href="#reserve" class="btn btn-solid">Reserve a table</a>
      <button class="hamburger" id="hamburger" aria-label="Menu"><span></span><span></span><span></span></button>
    </div>
  </nav>
</header>

<div class="mobile-drawer" id="mobile-drawer">
  <a href="#about">About</a>
  <a href="#menu">Menu</a>
  <a href="#reviews">Reviews</a>
  <a href="#visit">Visit</a>
  <a href="#reserve" class="btn btn-solid" style="text-align:center; margin-top: 12px;">Reserve a table</a>
</div>

<section class="hero" id="top">
  <div class="hero-bg"></div>
  <div class="wrap hero-inner">
    <div class="rating-tag"><span class="stars">★★★★★</span><span>4.7 · 1,023 Google reviews</span></div>
    <h1>A slow corner of Wakad, built from wood and light.</h1>
    <p class="lede">Bamboo ceilings, terrazzo floors, and a menu that moves from thecha chicken to burrata without apologizing for either. Women-owned, everyone welcome.</p>
    <div class="hero-actions">
      <a href="#menu" class="btn btn-solid">See the menu</a>
      <a href="#visit" class="btn btn-ghost">Get directions</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <a href="#menu" class="scroll-cue">Menu</a>
</section>

<div class="info-strip">
  <div class="wrap">
    <span>Dine-in</span><span>Kerbside pickup</span><span>No-contact delivery</span><span>Women-owned</span><span>LGBTQ+ friendly</span><span>Open till 11:30pm</span>
  </div>
</div>

<section class="about" id="about">
  <div class="wrap about-grid">
    <div class="reveal">
      <div class="eyebrow">The place</div>
      <h2>Named for the wind, built for lingering</h2>
      <div class="about-stats">
        <div class="stat"><div class="num" data-count="4.7">0</div><div class="label">Average rating</div></div>
        <div class="stat"><div class="num" data-count="1023">0</div><div class="label">Reviews and counting</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="about-copy reveal">
      <p>Zypher's sits inside Park Arcade on Park Street, a short walk from most of Wakad. The room does a lot of the talking — bamboo slat ceilings, warm wood staircases, bottle-green tile at the counter, and terrazzo underfoot.</p>
      <p>The kitchen doesn't sit still either: thecha-marinated chicken and pesto funghi share a menu with burrata, hummus, and a rotating list of sliders. Expect ₹200–1,200 a head depending on how far you let yourself go.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="gallery">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="gallery-head reveal">
      <div class="eyebrow">A closer look</div>
      <h2>What actually lands on the table</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="gallery-grid reveal-stagger">

<button class="to-top" id="to-top" aria-label="Back to top">&uarr;</button>

<script>
  // TODO: replace with Zypher's actual WhatsApp business number — country code + number, no + or spaces.
  // Example for an Indian number: "91XXXXXXXXXX"
  const CAFE_WHATSAPP_NUMBER = "91XXXXXXXXXX";

  /* ---- Header shadow on scroll ---- */
  const header = document.getElementById('site-header');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    header.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 10);
    toTopBtn.classList.toggle('visible', window.scrollY > 600);
  }, { passive: true });

  /* ---- Mobile drawer ---- */
  const hamburger = document.getElementById('hamburger');
  const drawer = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer');
  hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
    hamburger.classList.toggle('open');
    drawer.classList.toggle('open');
  });
  drawer.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((a) => a.addEventListener('click', () => {
    hamburger.classList.remove('open');
    drawer.classList.remove('open');
  }));

  /* ---- Scroll-spy active nav link ---- */
  const sections = ['about', 'menu', 'reviews', 'visit'].map((id) => document.getElementById(id));
  const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('#nav-links a');
  const spy = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        navLinks.forEach((a) => a.classList.toggle('active', a.getAttribute('href') === '#' + entry.target.id));
      }
    });
  }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -50% 0px' });
  sections.forEach((s) => s && spy.observe(s));

  /* ---- Reveal on scroll ---- */
  const revealItems = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal, .reveal-stagger');
  const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('in');
        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });
  revealItems.forEach((item) => revealObserver.observe(item));

  /* ---- Stat count-up ---- */
  const statObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach((entry) => {
      if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
      const el = entry.target;
      const target = parseFloat(el.dataset.count);
      const isDecimal = target % 1 !== 0;
      const duration = 1200;
      const start = performance.now();
      function tick(now) {
        const progress = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
        const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
        const value = target * eased;
        el.textContent = isDecimal ? value.toFixed(1) : Math.round(value).toLocaleString('en-IN');
        if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
        else el.textContent = isDecimal ? target.toFixed(1) : target.toLocaleString('en-IN');
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      statObserver.unobserve(el);
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.5 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.num[data-count]').forEach((el) => statObserver.observe(el));

  /* ---- Gallery lightbox (with prev/next) ---- */
  const lightbox = document.getElementById('lightbox');
  const lightboxImg = document.getElementById('lightbox-img');
  const lightboxCount = document.getElementById('lightbox-count');
  const galleryButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-grid button'));
  let currentIndex = 0;

  function showImage(index) {
    currentIndex = (index + galleryButtons.length) % galleryButtons.length;
    const img = galleryButtons[currentIndex].querySelector('img');
    lightboxImg.src = img.src;
    lightboxImg.alt = img.alt;
    lightboxCount.textContent = `${currentIndex + 1} / ${galleryButtons.length}`;
  }

  galleryButtons.forEach((btn, i) => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      showImage(i);
      lightbox.classList.add('open');
    });
  });

  function closeLightbox() { lightbox.classList.remove('open'); }
  document.getElementById('lightbox-close').addEventListener('click', closeLightbox);
  document.getElementById('lightbox-prev').addEventListener('click', () => showImage(currentIndex - 1));
  document.getElementById('lightbox-next').addEventListener('click', () => showImage(currentIndex + 1));
  lightbox.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (e.target === lightbox) closeLightbox(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (!lightbox.classList.contains('open')) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLightbox();
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') showImage(currentIndex - 1);
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') showImage(currentIndex + 1);
  });

  /* ---- Back to top ---- */
  const toTopBtn = document.getElementById('to-top');
  toTopBtn.addEventListener('click', () => window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }));

  /* ---- Reservation form -> WhatsApp ---- */
  const dateInput = document.getElementById('r-date');
  dateInput.min = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const form = document.getElementById('reserve-form');
  const note = document.getElementById('form-note');

  form.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();

    const name = document.getElementById('r-name').value.trim();
    const phone = document.getElementById('r-phone').value.trim();
    const date = document.getElementById('r-date').value;
    const time = document.getElementById('r-time').value;
    const guests = document.getElementById('r-guests').value;
    const notes = document.getElementById('r-notes').value.trim();

    if (!name || !phone || !date || !time || !guests) {
      note.textContent = "Please fill in name, phone, date, time and guests.";
      note.className = "form-note error";
      return;
    }
    if (!/^\d{7,15}$/.test(phone.replace(/\D/g, ''))) {
      note.textContent = "That phone number doesn't look right — digits only, please.";
      note.className = "form-note error";
      return;
    }

    const prettyDate = new Date(date + 'T00:00:00').toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' });

    let message = `Hi Zypher's, I'd like to reserve a table.\n\n`;
    message += `Name: ${name}\n`;
    message += `Phone: ${phone}\n`;
    message += `Date: ${prettyDate}\n`;
    message += `Time: ${time}\n`;
    message += `Guests: ${guests}\n`;
    if (notes) message += `Notes: ${notes}\n`;

    const waLink = `https://wa.me/${CAFE_WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent(message)}`;
    window.open(waLink, '_blank');

    note.textContent = "Opening WhatsApp with your request — send it and we'll confirm your table.";
    note.className = "form-note success";
  });
</script>

</body>
</html>
